This document 
outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, which must be carried out from 
three to six years as indicated by Y3:6 in the title block

This 
procedure was applied in Damanhour Thermal Power Plant3*65mw since 1976. The generator data: 
81.25MVA, 10.5KV, 4.45KA, PF=0.8, 50HZ, 3000 rpm, Y connection

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Mohamed Fatehy AboElkher, tested by eng.سمير 
عوف حسوب , accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station, 
and certified by eng. Sania Diab Attia Diab WDEPC inspection head sector and 
MPIS coordinator.

Work order must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should the suitable safety 
 category.

 with caution marks surrounding the work area.
